acceptanceCriteria.criterion: ingest_financial_document accepts file_content (base64 string) and filename parameters in addition to existing doc_path
Either doc_path OR (file_content + filename) must be provided, not both
Base64 content is decoded and written to temp file for processing by existing ingestion pipeline
Temp files are cleaned up after ingestion completes (success or failure)
File content exceeding 25MB is rejected with clear error message
Unsupported file extensions (.docx, .txt, etc.) are rejected with helpful error
Existing doc_path usage remains 100% backward compatible
Same changes applied to ingest_financial_document_async tool

doc.title: High-Level Architecture

dependencies.python: MCP server framework - @mcp.tool() decorator <package name="pydantic" version=">=2.0,<3.0">Data validation for tool parameters Base64 decoding - standard library Temporary file creation - standard library @contextmanager decorator - standard library Path manipulation for extension detection

constraints.constraint: KISS Principle: This is a ~600-800 line MVP. NO custom wrappers around FastMCP. Use SDKs EXACTLY as documented.
Backward Compatibility: Existing doc_path usage must remain 100% unchanged (AC7).
Size Limit: 25MB base64 encoded (~18MB decoded) - handles most financial documents.
Type Hints: All functions MUST have type hints for parameters and return values.
Docstrings: Google-style docstrings for all public functions with Args, Returns, Raises, Example sections.
Error Handling: Raise specific exceptions (ValueError for validation, DocumentProcessingError for processing) - never bare Exception.
Structured Logging: Use logger.info/error with extra={} context for all operations.
No New Dependencies: base64, tempfile, contextlib are stdlib - no additions to pyproject.toml required.
